# Laviano AI Solutions

> 24/7 AI receptionist for small businesses. Answers every call on the first ring, books appointments into the calendar, captures leads, and transfers urgent callers — on the business's existing phone number.

Laviano AI Solutions (lavianoai.com) builds custom AI receptionists and conversion-focused websites for local operators: HVAC, home services, salons and spas, law offices, vet clinics, auto shops, real estate, medical offices, boutique studios, and restaurants.

## Product

- AI receptionist: first-ring pickup, 24/7, unlimited concurrent calls
- Calendar booking: Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, Jobber, ServiceTitan
- Lead capture: name, number, intent, full transcript
- Live transfer by keyword, time of day, or rules you set
- SMS confirmations on the call
- Optional small-business website design and on-site AI chat agent

## Pricing

- Frontline: $500/month, 750 minutes included, $0.70/min overage
- Flagship: $999/month, multi-calendar, custom voice, dedicated support, CRM/API
- Cancel anytime. Live in about 10–14 days after a 30-minute discovery call.

## Setup

1. Discovery call (30 min) — hours, services, pricing, transfer rules
2. Custom build — you approve before any real call
3. Go live — forward the existing number
